question_stem:
A block is pulled by a force X in a straight line along a rough horizontal surface, as shown in
Fig. 3.1.
Assume that the total resistive force opposing the motion of the block is 0.80 N at all speeds of the
block.
The variation with time t of the magnitude of the force X is shown in Fig. 3.2.
question_stem_latex:
A block is pulled by a force X in a straight line along a rough horizontal surface, as shown in
Fig. 3.1.
Assume that the total resistive force opposing the motion of the block is 0.80 N at all speeds of the
block.
The variation with time t of the magnitude of the force X is shown in Fig. 3.2.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Determine the change in momentum of the block from time t = 0 to time t = 3.0 s.
change in momentum = kg m s^{-1}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text: Describe and explain the motion of the block between time t = 3.0 s and time t = 6.0 s.
parts.question_text_latex: Describe and explain the motion of the block between time t = 3.0 s and time t = 6.0 s.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Force X produces a total power of 2.0 W when moving the block between time t = 3.0 s
and time t = 6.0 s.
Calculate the distance moved by the block during this time interval.
distance = m

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
The block is at rest at time t = 0.
On Fig. 3.3, sketch a graph to show the variation of the momentum of the block with time t
from t = 0 to t = 6.0 s.
Numerical values of momentum are not required.
